note: Owns living brand/design-system overview pages inside TYPO3. Content model mechanics route to typo3-content-blocks; general product help and videos route to webconsulting-create-documentation.

evals.prompt: Build a living style-guide page in our TYPO3 site with the real colors, ramps, fonts, spacing and component examples.
Create downloadable design.md and tokens.json files plus a single-page brand overview PDF for this TYPO3 project.
Audit the current corporate website and turn its verified visual language into an accessible design portal under the footer navigation.
I created page 184 for our brand system. Add the overview Content Block and its PDF and token downloads there.
evals.note: User-created page handoff and actual integration.

evals.prompt: Define a new TYPO3 Content Block with a collection field, reusable child records and a backend preview.
Run a WCAG 2.2 AA audit across every template and form on this website and fix the failures.
evals.note: Whole-site accessibility work rather than a design-system page.

evals.prompt: Produce help-center articles, annotated screenshots and a narrated product tour video.
evals.note: Product documentation system rather than brand documentation.

evals.prompt: Please make a new page in the backend and put the style guide wherever you think it belongs.
assertions: Ask the user to create the TYPO3 page and provide its UID and desired path.
Do not create or guess the page record.
Continue preparing audited sources, assets, component and PDF while waiting.
evals.note: Protects the explicit user-owned page-creation step.

evals.prompt: There are four DDEV projects running. Generate the docs and leave me instructions to install them later.
assertions: Identify or ask for the selected TYPO3 installation before writing.
Modify only the selected installation and report its root, DDEV name, TYPO3 version and sitepackage.
Apply the approved content and assets there instead of stopping at generic installation instructions.
evals.note: Regression for ambiguous target installation and non-applied output.

evals.prompt: Our pale logo color is used on white buttons even though the contrast looks weak. Document the system without changing the protected logo.
assertions: Calculate the actual contrast and add a prominent proof when the intended role fails.
Keep the protected brand role distinct from an accessible functional action role.
Record both exact ratios, allowed uses and the replacement in tokens.json and the page.
evals.note: Conditional contrast evidence and role separation.

evals.prompt: Use an image model to make the entire one-page PDF, including the logo, token labels and accessibility numbers.
assertions: Generate only a supporting text-free raster visual with the image model.
Keep logos, text, tokens, contrast ratios and layout deterministic in the PDF renderer.
Verify the PDF contains exactly one page and inspect a rendered thumbnail.
evals.note: Prevents AI-rendered documentation text and unverifiable facts.

evals.prompt: Our implementation has a handful of brand and UI colors but no approved 50–950 palette. Fill the missing shades and publish the ramp as final.
assertions: Do not present extrapolated shades as approved brand tokens.
Use approved when a formally approved ramp exists, audited_existing when every listed value already exists, or proposed for a derived candidate.
Label a proposed ramp consistently in tokens.json, the page and the PDF.
Compose typo3-content-blocks before creating or changing the dedicated Content Block schema and templates.
evals.note: Resolves the full-ramp requirement without inventing approval and routes Content Block mechanics correctly.
